ctx.x: And they owned that plot of land?

Oh yes, oh yes. Well, actually Ringling Brothers is your biggest circus. But they had all kinds of different places in winter quarters. At one time or another in the Twenties...no, from 1910 to 1918, West Baden, Indiana, about six of the big circuses used to have winter quarters there for some reason nobody knows.
